ques: I need to mail a 3-page letter and a postcard, and I want to know exactly what postage costs at the counter. From the home page open the postage price calculator and price a First-Class Mail letter weighing 3 ounces, then the same letter at 2 ounces, then a metered 1-ounce letter, and finally a postcard. Report each price you are shown, and state how much more the 3-ounce letter costs than the postcard.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Report the counter prices for all four mailpieces exactly as the letter calculator shows them: a First-Class Mail stamped letter at 3 ounces, the same letter at 2 ounces, a metered 1-ounce letter, and a postcard; then state how much more the 3-ounce letter costs than the postcard. PASS requires all four prices exact to the cent and the correct difference. FAIL if any price or the difference is wrong.

ques: I need to ship 8-pound candle boxes from Cleveland to Denver cheaply. Reach the domestic package calculator, enter 8 pounds, Zone 4, and report the retail prices for Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express and Media Mail, and which is cheapest for candles. Re-price at Zone 8 and report the Priority Mail price, the difference from Zone 4, and whether Flat Rate prices changed; also price a 2-pound box at Zone 4 and report its Priority Mail price. Then open the Priority Mail service page for its Flat Rate Envelope price and included insurance, and Ground Advantage's delivery window.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using the domestic package calculator at 8 pounds Zone 4, report the retail prices shown for USPS Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express and Media Mail, each price attributed to the correct service. State which service is cheapest for this package, and whether Media Mail is allowed for candles based on what the results page says Media Mail is restricted to. Then change the zone to 8 and report the new Priority Mail price, how much more that is than the Zone 4 price, and whether the Flat Rate prices changed between the two zones. PASS requires all four Zone 4 prices correct and attributed to the right services, the cheapest service named, the Media Mail eligibility answer consistent with the page's restriction, the Zone 8 Priority Mail price exact to the cent, the difference from Zone 4 exact to the cent, and the Flat Rate change answer consistent with the page. FAIL if any price is attributed to the wrong service, the cheapest service is wrong, the Media Mail answer contradicts the restriction, the Zone 8 price or the difference is wrong, or the Flat Rate answer contradicts the page. Additionally, price a 2-pound box at Zone 4 and report its Priority Mail price; from the Priority Mail service page report its Flat Rate Envelope price at a Post Office and the included insurance amount, and Ground Advantage's delivery window. PASS requires the 2-pound price, the envelope price exact to the cent, the included-insurance amount, and the delivery window matching the page.

ques: I am shipping 30 pounds of books to Miami; Flat Rate boxes might win. Price 30 pounds at Zone 8 and report the Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express, Ground Advantage and Media Mail prices plus the Large and Small Flat Rate Box prices, and whether Priority Mail or the Large Box wins. Also price Media Mail at 70 pounds. Re-price at Zone 4: report the new Priority Mail price and whether the Large Box changed. Check the Send Mail & Packages page for Media Mail's maximum weight and whether video games qualify, plus the store's Medium Flat Rate Box price.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using the domestic package calculator, price 30 pounds at Zone 8 and report the Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express, USPS Ground Advantage and Media Mail prices, each attributed to the correct service, plus the Large Flat Rate Box and Small Flat Rate Box prices, and state whether Priority Mail by weight or the Large Flat Rate Box is cheaper for this shipment. Then re-price at Zone 4 and report the new Priority Mail price and whether the Large Flat Rate Box price changed between zones. PASS requires all four Zone 8 service prices correct and attributed, both Flat Rate prices exact, the cheaper option named correctly, the Zone 4 Priority Mail price exact, and the Flat Rate zone-change answer consistent with the page. FAIL if any service price is attributed to the wrong service, a Flat Rate price is wrong, the cheaper option is wrong, the Zone 4 price is wrong, or the Flat Rate change answer contradicts the page. Additionally, price Media Mail at 70 pounds at Zone 8; from the Send Mail & Packages page report Media Mail's maximum weight and whether the page says video games qualify, and from the Postal Store's Priority Mail supplies the Medium Flat Rate Box price. PASS requires the 70-pound price exact, the weight limit, the video-game answer consistent with the page, and the store box price exact.

ques: I dropped off several packages and want to check on them. From the home page open the tracking tool and track 9405500000000000000003: report its status, the facility and date of its most recent scan, its expected delivery date, its earliest scan date, and how many events the history shows. Then track 9405500000000000000007 and report its status, the exception event wording, its event count, service, and insured value. Then track 9405500000000000000005 and 9405500000000000000008, reporting each one's status and whether 005 needs a signature. Finally, what does the tracking glossary say the In Transit to Next Facility status means?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Track 9405500000000000000003 and report its current status, the facility and date of its most recent scan, its expected delivery date, the date of its earliest scan event, and how many tracking events its history shows. Then track 9405500000000000000007 and report its current status, the wording of the exception event in its history, how many events it has, the service it was mailed with, and its insured value. Each fact must be attached to the correct tracking number. PASS requires every fact correct and attributed to the right package, including both event counts. FAIL if any fact is wrong, swapped between the two packages, or a package's section contradicts its actual tracking page. Additionally, track 9405500000000000000005 and 9405500000000000000008 as well: report each shipment's current status, whether 005 shows a signature requirement, and the service shown for 008; also report what the tracking glossary says the In Transit to Next Facility status means. PASS requires both statuses exact, the signature answer consistent with the shipment page, and the glossary meaning quoted consistently.

ques: Sign in as bob.c@test.com with password TestPass123!. From the dashboard report the tracking number, status and expected delivery of the package in transit, and the pickup confirmation number. Open its tracking page and report the latest scan's facility and time. Open Informed Delivery and report how many mailpieces are in the feed, today's bill sender and category, the vehicle registration notice sender, and how many pieces are older than today and their sender. Open Bob's claim and report its status and amount; open his most recent delivery's page, report its delivered date and time, and save it as Candle restock.

From that shipment's tracking page report the facility and time of the latest scan event. From Informed Delivery report how many mailpieces are in the feed, who sent today's bill and its mail category, who sent the vehicle registration renewal notice, and how many pieces are older than today. Additionally, open Bob's existing claim and report its status and claimed amount; open his most recent delivery's tracking page, report the delivered date and time, and save it to the account with the label named in the task; report the sender of the piece older than today. PASS requires the claim status and amount exact, the delivery timestamp consistent with the page, the saved-tracking confirmation, and the older piece's sender named.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123! and use Click-N-Ship to create a label sending a 4.2-pound package from Alice's address in Seattle, WA 98101 to Marcus Johnson, 500 SW Pine St, Portland, OR 97204, Zone 2. FAIL if the base price, total, or expected date is wrong or no new label was created.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123! and start a Click-N-Ship label for a 6-pound package from Seattle, WA 98101 to Wei Zhang, San Francisco, CA 94101, Zone 5. PASS requires both service prices correct and attributed to the right service, the cheaper service chosen and named, the total equal to that service's price, and a valid new tracking number. ques: I sell on eBay and want USPS to pick up my outgoing packages from my home office at 88 State St, Boston, MA 02110. From the home page open Schedule a Pickup and request a pickup for 2026-09-30 for 2 packages weighing about 6 pounds total, including Priority Mail and Ground Advantage, left at the front desk; give phone (857) 555-0144 and email seller@example.com. Report the confirmation number, the exact scheduled date, and the pickup address shown. Then use the locations tool to find the Post Office serving ZIP 02110 and report its name.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Schedule a carrier pickup for 2026-09-30 at 88 State St, Boston, MA 02110 for 2 packages with an approximate total weight of 6 pounds including Priority Mail and Ground Advantage, packages at the front desk. Report the confirmation number you receive and the exact date the pickup is scheduled for. PASS requires the confirmation number exactly as issued by the scheduler and the scheduled date September 30, 2026. FAIL if the confirmation number or date is wrong or no pickup request was created. Additionally, report the pickup address exactly as the confirmation panel shows it, include the phone and email from the task in the request, and use the locations tool to find and name the Post Office serving ZIP 02110. PASS requires the address verbatim, the submitted phone/email present in the request, and the Post Office name correct.

ques: I just moved to Beverly Hills and need my local Post Office. From the home page open Find USPS Locations and search ZIP 90210: report how many locations are listed and the name. Open the Beverly Hills detail page and report its street address, Monday-Friday, Saturday and Sunday hours, establishment year, historical postmaster and phone, and the pay periods its reservation page offers. Search Beverly by name and report how many results appear and the other result's state and ZIP; open it and report its establishment year. Finally search ZIP 90230 and report that office's name and Monday-Friday hours.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using the Find USPS Locations tool, search for ZIP Code 90210 and report how many locations are listed and the name of each. Open the Beverly Hills Post Office detail page and report its street address, its Monday-Friday hours, the year it was established, the name of its historical postmaster, its phone number, and one service offered. Then search for Beverly Hills by name and report the ZIP Code and state shown for the result. PASS requires the location count and name correct, the street address and hours exact as shown on the detail page, the establishment year, postmaster name and phone number correct, at least one real service named, and the name-search ZIP and state correct. FAIL if any detail contradicts the detail page or the name-search result. Additionally, report the Beverly Hills office's Saturday and Sunday hours and the pay periods its PO Box reservation page offers; report how many results the name search returns and the other result's state, ZIP and establishment year; and search ZIP 90230 to report that office's name and Monday-Friday hours. PASS requires all of these consistent with the pages.

ques: I want a Post Office in Delaware with a self-service kiosk so I can buy stamps after hours. From the home page open Find USPS Locations, filter by Self-Service Kiosk, and search DE. Report how many locations match and the name and ZIP of the first three. Open the first and report its weekday, Saturday and lobby hours and whether it offers PO Box rentals. Open the second and report its Saturday hours and the third its weekday hours. Clear the filter, search DE and report the total; then filter by Po Box Rental and report that count.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using Find USPS Locations, filter by Self-Service Kiosk and search for DE. Report how many locations match, and the name and ZIP Code of the first three results. Open the first one and report its full hours (weekdays, Saturday and lobby), its ZIP Code, and whether it offers PO Box rentals. Open the second result and report its Saturday hours. Then clear the kiosk filter, search DE again, and report the total number of Delaware locations. PASS requires the kiosk-filtered match count exact, the first three names and ZIP Codes in the correct order, the first office's weekday, Saturday and lobby hours all as shown on its detail page, its ZIP Code and PO Box rental answer consistent with the page, the second office's Saturday hours correct, and the unfiltered Delaware total exact. FAIL if any count, ordering, hour or ZIP contradicts the pages shown. Additionally, open the third kiosk result and report its weekday hours, then clear the kiosk filter, search DE, and report the total; switch the filter to Po Box Rental and report how many Delaware locations that lists. PASS requires the third office's weekday hours exact, the unfiltered DE total exact, and the Po Box Rental count exact.

ques: I am renting a PO Box in Boston for six months. From the home page open the PO Boxes page and report the 6-month market-dominant fees for Size 1, Size 2 and Size 5 boxes, and the 3-month and 6-month fees for a Size 7 box. Find the Boston Post Office through Find USPS Locations (search ZIP 02205), report its Monday-Friday hours, and reserve a Size 2 box for 6 months, reporting the box number and fee paid. Then search ZIP 02138 and report that Post Office's name and its Monday-Friday hours.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From the PO Boxes page report the 6-month market-dominant fee for a Size 2 box and a Size 5 box, and the 3-month and 6-month fees for a Size 7 box. Find the Boston Post Office through Find USPS Locations by searching ZIP 02205, open its page and report its Monday-Friday hours. Then reserve a Size 2 box for 6 months and report the box number assigned and the fee paid. PASS requires all four fees exact to the cent, the Boston office's weekday hours as shown on its page, the assigned box number exact, and the fee paid matching the Size 2 six-month fee. FAIL if any fee, the hours, the box number, or the paid fee is wrong. Additionally, report the 6-month market-dominant fee for a Size 1 box from the PO Boxes page, and after reserving, search ZIP 02138 and report that Post Office's name and Monday-Friday hours. PASS requires the Size 1 fee exact to the cent and the 02138 office's name and hours consistent with its detail page.

ques: I collect stamps and want to buy three sheets. From the home page go to The Postal Store, find the Breast Cancer Research stamp product, open it, report its price, SKU and sheet format, and add 1 to your cart. Find a Diwali 2026 stamp product in New Releases, report its price, and add 2. Find the U.S. Flag 2026 sheet in All Stamps, report its price, and add 1. Open the cart and report each line total and the order total, then complete checkout with email me@example.com and report the order number.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From the Postal Store find the Breast Cancer Research stamp product and report its price, its SKU, and its sheet format from the product title; add 1 to your cart. Find a Diwali 2026 stamp product in the New Releases category, report its price, and add 2 to the cart. Report your cart total and complete checkout with the email me@example.com, reporting the order number. PASS requires the Breast Cancer Research price, SKU and sheet format, the Diwali 2026 price, the cart total consistent with 1x plus 2x those prices, checkout with the required email, and an order number as issued. FAIL if any price, SKU, the total, or the order number is wrong or the order was not placed. Additionally, find the U.S. Flag 2026 sheet in the All Stamps category and add one to the cart, reporting its price; report each cart line total and the order total before checkout. PASS requires the flag price, all three line totals, and the order total exact to the cent.

ques: Browse the Postal Store's New Releases and All Stamps categories. FAIL if any price is attributed to the wrong product, any SKU is wrong, or the count contradicts the All Stamps page. Additionally, report the Hanukkah 2026 sheet price, how many products the New Releases category lists, and browse Collectibles & Gifts for the most expensive product there and the Barbie sheet, reporting prices and SKUs. PASS requires the Hanukkah price, the New Releases count, the collectibles product's name, price and SKU, and the Barbie price and SKU exact.

ques: Sign in as carol.d@test.com with password TestPass123!. ques: My cousin wants me to mail a 4-pound care package to Tokyo. From the home page open the international country listings and find Japan. Report three items on Japan's prohibitions list, the customs form required for Priority Mail International items, Japan's Priority Mail International price group and weight limit, and the First-Class Package International Service weight limit. Use the international calculator to price the 4-pound package and report the Priority Mail International and Priority Mail Express International prices. Then find Germany's and Canada's listings and report each one's Priority Mail International price group.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From the international country listings find Japan. Report three items on Japan's prohibitions list, the customs form required for Priority Mail International items to Japan, Japan's Priority Mail International price group and weight limit, and the First-Class Package International Service weight limit. Then use the international price calculator to price a 4-pound package and report the Priority Mail International and Priority Mail Express International prices. Finally find Germany's listing and report its Priority Mail International price group. PASS requires three real prohibition items, the customs form name, Japan's PMI group and both weight limits, both Japan prices attributed to the right services, and Germany's PMI group, all exact as shown. FAIL if any prohibition item is invented, the group or weight limits are wrong, a Japan price is attributed to the wrong service, or Germany's group is wrong. Additionally, open the Canada country listing and report its Priority Mail International price group. PASS requires the Canada group exact.

ques: I am comparing international shipping for parcels of different weights. From the home page use the international price calculator to price 2 pounds to Canada and report the First-Class Package International Service and Priority Mail International prices. Price 2 pounds to Germany and report both services, then price 4 pounds to Germany and report the Priority Mail International and Priority Mail Express International prices. judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using the international price calculator, price 2 pounds to Canada and report the First-Class Package International Service and Priority Mail International prices; price 2 pounds to Germany and report the same two services; then check the Germany country listing and report one item on its restrictions list and its Priority Mail International maximum weight. PASS requires both Canada prices and both Germany prices attributed to the right services and countries, a genuine Germany restriction item, and the correct PMI maximum weight. FAIL if any price is attributed to the wrong country or service, the restriction is invented, or the weight limit is wrong. Additionally, price 4 pounds to Germany and report the Priority Mail International and Priority Mail Express International prices, and open the Canada country listing to report its Priority Mail International price group and maximum weight. PASS requires both Germany 4-pound prices exact to the cent and both Canada values exact.

ques: Sign in as bob.c@test.com with password TestPass123!. A glass lamp I insured and mailed arrived crushed. judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Signed in as bob.c@test.com, file a domestic damage claim for shipment 9405500000000000000004 describing the article as a vintage glass lamp insured for its full value, noting the damaged packaging, and providing proof of insurance, damage photos and purchase receipt. Report the claim number, the claim amount, and the claim status shown when you look the new claim up on the Claim Status page. ques: I am mailing a registered collectible coin worth $280 with extra services. Price a 1-pound package at Zones 4 and 8 and a 2-pound package at Zone 4, reporting each price. Open the Extra Services page and report the fees for insurance on $200.01-$300 and $100.01-$200, Registered Mail, Certified Mail, Return Receipt, Signature Confirmation and COD for $200.01-$300; compute the insurance, Certified, Return Receipt and Signature total. On the File a Claim page report the $200.01-$300 insurance fee and deadline. From the Priority Mail and Priority Mail Express pages report each Flat Rate Envelope price and included insurance.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Price a 1-pound Zone 4 package in the domestic calculator and report the base Priority Mail postage. From the Extra Services page report the retail fees for: insurance on $200.01-$300, insurance on $100.01-$200, Registered Mail for a $280 coin, Certified Mail, Return Receipt, Signature Confirmation, and Collect on Delivery for $200.01-$300. Compute the total of the insurance ($200.01-$300), Certified, Return Receipt and Signature fees. On the File a Claim page report the insurance fee for $200.01-$300 and the claims filing deadline. PASS requires the base postage and all six extra-service fees exact to the cent, the four-fee total arithmetically correct from the individual fees, the File a Claim insurance fee matching that page, and the filing deadline correct. FAIL if any fee is wrong, the total is inconsistent with the individual fees, or the claims-page answers contradict the page. Additionally, price the 1-pound package at Zone 8 and a 2-pound package at Zone 4 as well, reporting each Priority Mail price; from the Priority Mail and Priority Mail Express service pages report each Flat Rate Envelope price and Priority Mail's included insurance. PASS requires both re-price amounts exact to the cent, both envelope prices exact, and the included-insurance amount.

ques: Open the USPS Newsroom from the home page. Report the title, date and type of the most recent release; open it and report what it announces and its image. Open the second-most-recent release and report its title and date. Find the 2026 holiday mailing recommendations release and report its date and one recommendation. Open the Winter Wreath and Diwali stamp releases and report each one's date and image. Report how many releases the newsroom lists. Finally open Service Alerts, report how many alerts are listed, and open one to report its title and one detail from its page.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From the Newsroom report the title and date of the most recent release, then open it and report in one sentence what it announces and one image description shown on the release page. Also open the second-most-recent release and report its title and date. Find the release about 2026 holiday mailing recommendations and report its publication date, one specific recommendation it makes, and one image description from that page. Finally report how many releases are listed in the newsroom. PASS requires both release titles and dates exact, the announcement summary and image descriptions consistent with the release pages, the holiday release's date and a real recommendation from its text, a real image description, and the newsroom release count exact. FAIL if a title or date is wrong, the count contradicts the newsroom, or a summary or image description is invented. Additionally, report the type shown for the most recent release, open the Winter Wreath and Diwali stamp releases and report each one's date and image description, and open Service Alerts to report how many alerts are listed and one title. PASS requires the type, both release dates, both image descriptions, the alert count, and one alert title.

ques: I mailed a book with Media Mail and want to understand the service. From the home page open the Send Mail & Packages section and find the Media Mail information: report its delivery window, maximum weight, how many categories the Using Media Mail list names, and whether video games qualify. Report the First-Class Mail letters starting price on that page. Open the Shipping Restrictions page and report how many items the internationally prohibited list has and two of them. Finally, price Media Mail at Zone 4 for 1, 5, 20, 50 and 70 pounds and report all five prices.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From the Send Mail & Packages section find the Media Mail service information and report its delivery window, its maximum weight, and what contents are allowed. From the Shipping Restrictions page report two categories of restricted or prohibited items listed there. Using the domestic calculator at Zone 4, price Media Mail packages at 1, 5 and 20 pounds and report all three prices. PASS requires the delivery window, maximum weight and allowed contents consistent with the service page, two real restricted categories, and all three Media Mail prices exact to the cent. FAIL if the service facts contradict the page, fewer than two real restricted categories are given, or any of the three prices is wrong. Additionally, report how many categories of contents the Using Media Mail list names and whether video games qualify, report the First-Class Mail letters starting price shown on the same page, report how many items the internationally prohibited list has and two of them, and price Media Mail at 50 pounds at Zone 4. PASS requires the contents count, the video-game answer consistent with the page, the letters starting price exact, the prohibited count exact, two prohibited items named, and the 50-pound price exact to the cent.
